Video Safe-Zone Checker

Preview TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts UI overlays to avoid cropped text. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Overlays precise 9:16 vertical safe zone boundaries for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts over your videos or frame grabs. Highlights critical obstruction zones where usernames, engagement action buttons (likes, shares, comments), audio discs, and captions cover screen content.

How to use

  1. Select your target social media platform (TikTok UI, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts).
  2. Upload a short-form video clip (MP4, WebM, or MOV) or a static 9:16 frame export.
  3. Examine the red overlay guide showing where platform interface elements will appear.
  4. Download the overlaid guide image to adjust title placement and subtitle positioning in your video editor.

Limits & Considerations

Extracts and evaluates representative video frames for UI alignment. Does not re-render, compress, or re-encode full multi-minute video streams.

Privacy & Security

Video frames are extracted locally using HTML5 Video elements and Canvas. Video files never travel across the network to external servers.
